# @cmc/ui — CMC EDU design system (agent brief)

> Stack: React + CSS custom properties + Astryx primitives. **Do not** install shadcn/Tailwind as a second system.
> Brand: one interactive blue `#0071E3`. Font: Inter. Canvas: warm paper `#f5f3ee`.

## Closed tokens (use only these)

See `src/tokens.css`. Key roles:

- Brand: `--cmc-brand`, `--cmc-brand-hover`, `--cmc-brand-muted`, `--cmc-brand-ink`
- Text: `--cmc-text`, `--cmc-text-2`, `--cmc-text-muted`, `--cmc-text-faint`
- Surface: `--cmc-canvas`, `--cmc-surface-raised`, `--cmc-surface-2`, `--cmc-surface-sunken`
- Border: `--cmc-border`, `--cmc-border-subtle`
- Radius: control 12 · card/md 16 · dialog/lg 20 · pill
- Elevation: shadow-xs (sticky) · sm (raised rest) · md (hover) · lg (modal)
- Status solid: success / warning / danger · soft pairs for chips
- Focus: `--cmc-focus-halo`

**Do not invent** new accent colors, cool gray `#f5f5f7` / `#d4d4d4`, or radius 4px.

## Nested harmony

```
control 12 ≤ card 16 ≤ dialog 20
sunken field → raised card → floating overlay
```

## Structure system (anti-fragmentation)

All raised composites share:
- `--cmc-raised-bg|border|shadow|radius`
- `--cmc-keyline-x` horizontal inset
- `--cmc-row-h` / `--cmc-head-h` / `--cmc-chip-h*` / `--cmc-cta-h*`
- 1-line title/meta truncate (+ title tooltip)

Full rules: `design-system/cmc-edu/STRUCTURE.md`.

## Page frames (mandatory)

`DashboardPage` | `ListPage` | `DetailPage` | `FormPage` — see `design-system/cmc-edu/PAGE-FRAMES.md`.

**A11y baseline (partial, role smoke — not WCAG cert):** `design-system/cmc-edu/A11Y-BASELINE.md`.

**Interaction grammar (Odoo map, ControlBar, exemptions):** `design-system/cmc-edu/VIEW-GRAMMAR.md`.

List chrome: `ListPage` embeds **ControlBar** (header · filters · footer/pager; quiet sticky surface).

FilterBar types: `text` | `select` | `date`.

## Composites (import from `@cmc/ui`)

| Role | Component |
|------|-----------|
| Metric | MetricCard, InsightMetric, FocusCard |
| Pipeline | FunnelBar, StageFunnel (stack\|rail\|split) |
| Queue | WorkInbox, TaskRow, Panel |
| List | FilterBar, DataTable (optional selection), BulkActionBar, ListPagination |
| Detail frame | **DetailPage** — tiers: **full** (EH+HS+WF) · **standard** (EH+HS) · **settings** (SettingsShell) · **thin** (ops residual). See `design-system/cmc-edu/PAGE-FRAMES.md` §C |
| Detail atoms | EntityHeader, HighlightStrip, StatActions, WorkflowStatusbar, KeyValueList, SectionBlock, CmcTabs |
| Form | FormPage, ProgressSteps, ResultPanel |
| Settings | SettingsSection, SettingsRow |
| Feedback | Toast, Banner, Callout, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState |
| Identity | Avatar, MetaRow/MetaItem, CountBadge |
| Schedule (edu) | SessionCard (P0 time/title/status/CTA, P1 program, P2 room/GV, P3 tooltip) |
| Status | StatusBadge appearance soft (default) \| solid |
| Shell | ConsoleNavbar, PageHeader, CommandPalette (⌘K) |
| Settings | SettingsShell (rail), SettingsSection, SettingsRow |
| Auth | TextField, PasswordInput |

## Xia port rules (from ~/Downloads/design)

Port patterns only from Shopify / GitHub / Cal / Airbnb DESIGN.md:
- Port: Callout, soft status, MetaRow, CountBadge, Avatar, Timeline, Settings
- Skip: their brand colors, sharp 3–6px radius as default, marketing sparsity, dual CTA accents


CSS: admin imports `@cmc/ui/tokens.css` then `astryx-theme-cmc.css` then `console.css` once at app root. LMS uses `apps/lms/src/app.css` (does not import `console.css`).
